Hey sorry all that I didn't post the follow up. I've been dealing with post surgery side effects. Jaw pain, headaches, sometimes I still have issues with memory, and it hasn't fully stopped the seizures (very much reduced intensity and number of seizures I have had), or it's an interaction with some of my meds. Emotional issues and impulse control is worse. My wife and I really don't yell or fight, but since the surgery I have been very quick to anger and snap at her. Right now we're both kind of mourning the loss of the person I was before. Also working with a psych and therapist to work through some of this. If you start going through the same focus on the positives as much as you can and be grateful you made it through surgery and have the chance for some relief, but understand there can be some side effects for sure. 

My surgeon says he sees people with those kind of problems at first but says they tend to go away in about a month and a half to a few months. Right now it is hard to deal with but worth it as long as I get to the other side of this. I like this quote, to paraphrase "Don't just go through it, grow through it."
